message.content: On July 7, 2026, LiHua expressed concern about the condition of the basement after recent rainstorms. In her message, she specifically asked Adam if there were any issues in the basement after those storms, indicating that she had noticed potential problems and wanted to ensure everything was safe. Adam reassured her that everything seemed fine, but advised her to keep an eye on the area and report any unusual occurrences. This exchange highlights LiHua's proactive approach to addressing safety concerns, which led to Adam's reminder to monitor the basement's condition. Adam also offered to provide the contact information for the maintenance worker, demonstrating his commitment to ensuring the property remains in good condition for both tenants.
